planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; required wiring is A1 (light sensor input) and D8 (LED output).
No serial reporting or serial command inputs are specified in the requirements.
The threshold comparison and LED control logic are implemented in the SysML model; this proposal only registers the required IO ports.
Sensor sampling is scheduled at the control period (5 ms) and SysML performs thresholding using the model state.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Light intensity from photoresistor; compare against SysML threshold to decide LED on/off

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED that is lit when measured light intensity is below the SysML threshold

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 使用 A1 光敏电阻检测光强，当低于阈值时点亮 D8 LED。
